digest.component_or_area: test reliability oracles for subprocess and network I/O
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted runs a 15-second real loopback server and must be reduced to sub-second injected window while maintaining above-floor byte transfer semantics and non-stall assertion
test_read_retried_then_terminal uses production 1-second call timeout and real 2s/4s backoff sleeps causing ~9s total elapsed time and must record logical retry schedule without sleeping
both tests must retain real socket/process execution, exact attempt/retry semantics, and production configuration defaults while completing in low single-digit seconds
slow-progress test must verify real loopback socket transfers above configured floor for more than one complete injected window
ACLI read retry must record every spawned PID and poll to verify no child processes survive after terminal failure
